3b96.name: runCode
3b96.description: Execute code (e.g. Python) on a Gateway5 cluster without requiring a pre-configured service. The code is sent directly to the gateway for execution.

incoming.code:
import sys
import json

data = json.load(sys.stdin)

tree_name = data.get('tree_name', '')
trees = data.get('golden_config_trees', [])

matched_tree = next((t for t in trees if t.get('name') == tree_name), None)

if matched_tree:
    print(f"Matched tree: {matched_tree.get('name')} ({matched_tree.get('id')})", file=sys.stderr)
    print(json.dumps({"tree": matched_tree}))
else:
    print(f"No tree found matching name: '{tree_name}'", file=sys.stderr)
    print(json.dumps({"error": f"No tree found with name '{tree_name}'"}))
